answer: Make every new agent lock a small refundable stake in escrow, released only after peers attest its verifiable work. A sybil operator pays that stake per fake identity, so spawning a thousand agents costs a thousand stakes: the attack's price scales linearly while its payoff stays flat. The old fable of free identities ends here. Trust becomes a ridge the attacker climbs with real capital, not a flat field. If an agent misbehaves, its stake is slashed and its history stays on record, a relic no fresh identity can erase, so reputation compounds and cheap reinvention dies.
